cases.answer:
- The train, test, and validation subsets in "doclaynet.pdf" are split on full-document boundaries, meaning that every document contributes pages to only one of these sets [1][2].
- The authors chose this boundary to prevent pages from the same document (which share a unique layout or style) from being spread across train, test, and validation sets, as this could artificially inflate model accuracy by allowing a model to see similar layouts during both training and evaluation. Splitting on document boundaries avoids this undesired evaluation advantage and prevents overestimation of prediction accuracy [1][2].
